title: Understanding Bias and Variance
text: Remember that bias measures how far off the model's predictions are from the actual values on average, while variance measures how much the model's predictions vary for different datasets. Consider how these two components might affect the model's performance.

title: Comparing Bias and Variance
text: Model A has a lower bias squared but higher variance compared to Model B. Think about how this trade-off might influence the choice of regression technique.

title: Exploring Ridge Regression and OLS
text: Which regression technique is more likely to have a higher variance, Ridge Regression with $$\lambda>0$$ or OLS?

title: Impact of Regularization
text: Ridge Regression includes a regularization term that can help reduce variance. Consider how this might affect the bias and variance of a model.

title: Analyzing Model A and Model B
text: Given that Model A has higher variance and lower bias squared compared to Model B, which model is more likely to have used Ridge Regression?
